# Vericeus

> Vericeus is a physician-led healthcare consultancy in the Philippines. It advises on medical AI evaluation and Filipino health data strategy, with the mission of consolidated, consented local health data for Filipino patients. Founded and run by Christian Bernardo, MD, a physician with 25 years of clinical practice who evaluates AI-generated health answers. Tagline: "Truth in Filipino health data." Contact by email only: cbernardo@vericeus.com

## Services

- [Clinical AI evaluation](https://vericeus.com/#services): Expert review of AI-generated medical answers, with rubrics, error categories, and testing for Filipino context (Tagalog and Taglish questions, local disease burden, Philippine clinical guidelines).
- [Health data and AI strategy](https://vericeus.com/#services): Feasibility and planning for using Philippine health data responsibly, including Data Privacy Act governance, consent, partner mapping, and pilot scoping. Not legal advice.
- [Manifesto](https://vericeus.com/manifesto/): Why Filipino health data must be consolidated for better, lower-cost care, why AI must serve every Filipino, and what Vericeus commits to.
- [Team](https://vericeus.com/#team) and [FAQ](https://vericeus.com/#faq).

## Insights (articles written and clinically reviewed by Vericeus)

- [Will Healthcare AI Work for Filipino Patients? Why Local Validation Matters](https://vericeus.com/insights/healthcare-ai-filipino-patients/): Why AI trained overseas needs local validation in the Philippines, with Philippine evidence on diabetic eye disease and TB screening, data control, and what hospitals should check.
- [What China's AI Cooperation Initiative Could Mean for Healthcare in the Philippines](https://vericeus.com/insights/china-ai-cooperation-healthcare-philippines/): Where AI could help Philippine healthcare most and the safeguards needed.
- [Can Extreme Heat Damage Your Kidneys? Causes, Warning Signs, and Prevention](https://vericeus.com/insights/extreme-heat-kidney-health/): How heat and dehydration can cause acute kidney injury, warning signs, and prevention.
- [RSS feed](https://vericeus.com/feed.xml)
